QuestInfo.name: A Request from Sergeant Bravo
QuestInfo.1: I found Sergeant Bravo at the snowfield, and he asked me to get him #b2 refined #t4011003#s#k while giving me an item which is to be given to Master Sergeant Fox.
QuestInfo.2: I brought two Adamantium to Sergeant Bravo. He seems to give something to Master Sergeant Fox...

0.1: It is good to hear that he is alive. So he is working at El Nath huh? Okay... I found #b#t4031049##k and this would be somewhat related to our mission.
